summary: Texas Forest Service steel lookout No. 7 near Conroe. A 2010 column says a tower moved from near Conroe in 1976 now stands at the Texas Forest Museum in Lufkin, altered against climbing; the column does not name No. 7, so that link is probable, not confirmed.

notes_for_editor: Identity link: the Lufkin tower is said to have been moved from near Conroe (Bowman column, source 3). No source names the NGS tower No. 7 and the Lufkin tower together, so the match is probable, not confirmed. Build year: the column gives 1936 only for towers 'such as' the Lufkin one, so no build event is dated for this tower. Height: the NGS point is the apex of the crow's-nest roof, so its 105 ft may not be cab-floor height; the column says 100 ft. record height_m 32.0 was left unchanged. Name: J.G. Jones (source 1) vs W.C. Jones S.F. (source 2) is unresolved. Current display and museum hours were not verified (texasforestmuseum sites did not resolve); the access level 'public' is an inference from museum display. Leads not read: the book Fire in the Piney Woods (Texas lookout towers), and the museum itself.
